item.title: HISTORICALLY YOURS
item.description: Mary Aldis was born April 4, 1719, in Dedham, Massachusetts, the daughter of Nathan and Mary (Chickering) Aldis. She married Abel Allen Jr on March 26, 1739, in Boston, but their marriage was short-lived as Allen died on May 13, 1742. Mary later married Moses Draper on November 26, 1743. The couple was blessed with six children, a daughter and five sons. They made their home on a farm and dairy which was on the border of Dedham and Roxbury.
